notes: Defines core entities, fields, and the shared API error shape for the MVP. Not an ORM/migration script — a contract for frontend/backend agreement.

User.description: Local shadow record synced from the external identity provider on first login.

identityProviderId.description: Subject/user ID from the external IdP.

Household.description: The central tenancy boundary. All shared resources belong to a household.

timezone.description: IANA timezone string, e.g. 'America/Chicago'. Used for display and recurrence generation.

inviteCode.description: Shareable code/link token used for self-join.

isDeleted.note: Household deletion is deferred past MVP; field reserved for future use.

HouseholdMembership.description: Join entity between User and Household. Structured as many-to-many now to support multi-household later, though MVP enforces one active household per user at the application layer.

Task.description: A household task/chore. Supports optional assignment and open-pool claiming.

assignedUserId.note: Null = open for any member to claim.

recurrenceId.description: Shared across all generated instances of the same recurring task.

rowVersion.description: Postgres system column used as the EF Core optimistic concurrency token.

RecurrenceRule.description: Defines the recurrence pattern used to generate Task or CalendarEvent instances.

isActive.description: Set false to stop future generation without deleting past instances.

List.description: A shared list (grocery, supplies, or custom).

ListItem.description: An item within a List. Checked items remain visible until manually cleared.

CalendarEvent.description: A household calendar event. Participants are informational tags only, not a visibility filter.

CalendarEventParticipant.description: Informational tagging of a user against an event. Does not restrict visibility.

ActivityEvent.description: A record of a change within a household, for the activity feed. Persists even if the referenced entity is later soft-deleted.

summary.description: Denormalized human-readable snapshot, e.g. 'Alex claimed Take out trash', so the feed remains readable even if the source entity changes or is deleted later.

apiErrorShape.description: Consistent error response shape returned by the global exception-handling middleware for all endpoints.

error.message: This task was updated by someone else. Refresh and try again.

realtimeEvents.description: SignalR events broadcast to the household group (household-{householdId}) after a successful write.
